INSERT INTO tv_watch_states (id, episode_id, user_id, watched, watched_at, source)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, TRUE, $4, $5)
        ON CONFLICT (episode_id, user_id)
        DO UPDATE SET
            watched = TRUE,
            watched_at = GREATEST(tv_watch_states.watched_at, EXCLUDED.watched_at),
            updated_at = NOW()
        RETURNING id
